· intro h
    subst hV
    suffices ∀ (x : M) (hx : x ∈ span R S), f ⟨x, hx⟩ = g ⟨x, hx⟩ by
      ext ⟨x, hx⟩

    | mem x hx => exact h ⟨x, hx⟩
    | zero => erw [map_zero, map_zero]
    | add x y hx hy hx' hy' =>
        erw [f.map_add ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩, g.map_add ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩]
        rw [hx', hy']
    | smul a x hx hx' =>
        erw [f.map_smul a ⟨x, hx⟩, g.map_smul a ⟨x, hx⟩]
        rw [hx']
